parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation; same-sex conduct decriminalised since 2007; Supreme Court recognises self-determined gender, pride events, inclusive curriculum and LGBT organisations operate. Visitor documents come from home country, so the difficult resident marker-change process is largely a climate signal. Weighing against: documented street-level exposure for visibly trans people — discrimination in public spaces and government institutions plus frequent physical and sexual harassment (Nov 2024), rising political hostility culminating in 2026 hate speech and death threats, and conversion therapy practised. Worst feature is tier-3 societal hostility with partial, unproven recourse rather than state-imposed universal exposure or criminalisation. No trans-specific killing magnitude is documented. Net: elevated-to-reduced risk for an outed visitor.
